title: Pentaryn Movement
description: Players' own tokens draw on top for them (client-side: their tokens take the click when tokens overlap; nothing is written to the scene). A ghost button in the token tools lets a player move their own tokens through walls and creatures, reusing core's unconstrained-movement constrain options (ignoreWalls, ignoreCost, and dnd5e's ignoreTokens); their tokens look see-through while it is on. The GM governs it with a world setting (Off / Exploration only / Always allowed; Exploration only switches it off while a combat is running on the scene) and a toolbar button that flips it off and back. An incorporeal creature (a feat named Incorporeal Passage / Movement or Ethereal, or the GM's Token HUD toggle) keeps ghosting during a fight. Drag help (0.10.0, the leader rule: within 4 s of the drop every token is on its way or named in a notice, nothing waits for another mover): dragging a token past a wall or a token standing in the way finds the shortest way around it (open doors only, a large token only where its body fits, players only round walls they have seen, and any passage shape: a way narrower than a square is walked on its centre line, off the grid), and clicking a moving token stops it where it is drawn (in a fight at the next square, so the movement spent stays exact); several tokens dragged together follow the token you grab: dropped on the floor they march (the leader on the drop square, the rest behind its last step, single file only at a narrow point, the pack one wave after the leader), dropped on a token outside the group that you can see they swarm round it from their own sides, ring by ring; the leader passes through its own group, drawn on top; one with no free square it can reach stays and is named, and a leader with no way moves nobody ("No route there"); in a fight they walk one at a time (the leader, then least walk left), each a normal single move routed at its turn, charged exactly core's measure, a member out of movement stopping on the last square it pays for (more than 24 are refused with a notice); a click on any member of a moving group stops the whole group. Tokens that start stacked stay stacked. Fail-open to core's move, a circuit breaker that switches the drag help off after repeated failures and tells the GM, per-client telemetry and an Alt+W key that files the last ten seconds through pentaryn-feedback. A GM toolbar button turns the drag help off for the table. Exposes game.pentaryn.movement.

afterSync: First install: restart Foundry (module.json is read at startup), enable 'Pentaryn Movement', then reload.
Players get a Ghost toggle in the token tools; the GM sets the policy in settings.
